--- pipe_join_subquery.sql
FROM LeftTable AS l
|> JOIN (SELECT 1 AS id) AS r ON l.id = r.id

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 14,
            Name:    "LeftTable",
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    15,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 18,
              NameEnd: 19,
              Name:    "l",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:  20,
        Op:    "INNER JOIN",
        Right: &ast.SubQueryTableExpr{
          Lparen: 28,
          Rparen: 43,
          Query:  &ast.Select{
            Select:  29,
            Results: []ast.SelectItem{
              &ast.Alias{
                Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
                  ValuePos: 36,
                  ValueEnd: 37,
                  Base:     10,
                  Value:    "1",
                },
                As: &ast.AsAlias{
                  As:    38,
                  Alias: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 41,
                    NameEnd: 43,
                    Name:    "id",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          As: &ast.AsAlias{
            As:    45,
            Alias: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 48,
              NameEnd: 49,
              Name:    "r",
            },
          },
        },
        Cond: &ast.On{
          On:   50,
          Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
            Op:   "=",
            Left: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 53,
                  NameEnd: 54,
                  Name:    "l",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 55,
                  NameEnd: 57,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
            Right: &ast.Path{
              Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 60,
                  NameEnd: 61,
                  Name:    "r",
                },
                &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 62,
                  NameEnd: 64,
                  Name:    "id",
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LeftTable AS l |> INNER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS id) AS r ON l.id = r.id
